fields.description: The accent. Blank uses the specification accent. Any colour is safe: the hover, the selected wash and the button label are derived from it, and it is lifted in dark mode so it stays legible against a dark page.
fields.label: Accent Colour

fields.description: The navbar and sidebar ground. Blank uses the specification chrome. The hover step, the selected item, the edge and both text colours are derived from it, so a light chrome gets dark labels automatically.
fields.label: Chrome Colour

fields.description: Shipped with the app. Standard palettes are restored on every migrate, so edits to them are overwritten. Duplicate one instead.
fields.label: Standard
